errors.evidence: The donut chart displays seven distinct categories, not six.

errors.text_span: The slices are arranged in descending order of size
errors.evidence: The slices are not arranged in descending order. For example, the largest slice, "External News Article" (15/38), is adjacent to "Interview" (2/38), which is one of the smallest slices.
The slice corresponding to "Draft/Other" is dark red, not purple.
The slice for "Organizational Report" is light purple/mauve. The dark green slice represents "External News Article".
The description incorrectly combines two separate categories, "Intra-agency news article (1/38)" and "Press Release (4/38)", into a single non-existent category.

This value is assigned to the incorrectly combined category "Intra-agency News Article Press Release". The two actual slices are "Intra-agency news article" (1/38, approx. 2.6%) and "Press Release" (4/38, approx. 10.5%). Neither is 5%, and their sum is approx. 13.1%.

The description fails to mention the "Press Release" (4/38) and "Intra-agency news article" (1/38) slices as distinct items. It omits the description for the "Press Release" slice (yellow/gold color, 4/38) entirely.

errors.text_span: The chart includes a legend identifying each category
errors.evidence: The chart does not have a separate legend box; instead, it has labels positioned directly next to each corresponding slice.

errors.text_span: and visual emphasis is applied to this central area
errors.evidence: Stating that the central area has "visual emphasis" is a subjective interpretation, not an objective description of a specific feature like an exploded slice. The prompt asks to avoid interpretation.
